title: Potential anti-glioma targets and mechanisms of Smilax china L. based on network pharmacological, molecular docking and experimental verification.
authors: Jin, Zhiyong; Jiang, Shan; Ma, Sicheng; Dong, Sijie; Xiao, Changzhou; Yuan, Liujie; Zhang, Feifan; Zhu, Mengyao; Li, Gang; Yu, Rutong
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证研究中药菝葜抗胶质瘤的靶点与机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Glioma, the most common primary malignant brain tumor, urgently requires effective treatments. Traditional Chinese herbal medicine, with its multi-target and low side effects, shows potential in anti-tumor treatment. Smilax china L. (SCL) resists various tumors, but its effect on gliomas is unknown. This study evaluated the impact and mechanism of SCL on glioma. Results showed intragastric administration of 0.5 and 1.5 g/kg SCL significantly inhibited glioma growth and prolonged survival in tumor-bearing mice. Bioinformatics analysis identified 84 intersection targets SCL and glioma. GO and KEGG analyses suggested that the EGFR/Akt/mTOR and EGFR/STAT3 pathways play important roles. Molecular docking highlighted Diosgenin and Pseudodiosgenin as key active compounds with strong binding ability to screened targets. In vitro verification confirmed these compounds inhibited glioma cell proliferation and induced apoptosis. Western blot analysis confirmed that SCL inhibits glioma via the EGFR/Akt/mTOR and EGFR/STAT3 pathways. Collectively, our findings comprehensively elucidated the active compounds, potential targets, and molecular mechanisms of SCL against glioma, providing a promising strategy for the scientific basis and therapeutic mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions for the treatment of the disease.
abstract_zh: 胶质瘤作为最常见的原发性恶性脑肿瘤，亟需有效的治疗方法。传统中草药凭借其多靶点和低副作用的特点，在抗肿瘤治疗中展现出潜力。菝葜（Smilax china L., SCL）能抵抗多种肿瘤，但其对胶质瘤的作用尚不明确。本研究评估了SCL对胶质瘤的影响及其机制。结果显示，以0.5和1.5 g/kg剂量灌胃给予SCL能显著抑制胶质瘤生长，并延长荷瘤小鼠的生存期。生物信息学分析确定了SCL与胶质瘤的84个交集靶点。GO和KEGG分析提示EGFR/Akt/mTOR和EGFR/STAT3通路发挥重要作用。分子对接强调薯蓣皂苷元（Diosgenin）和伪薯蓣皂苷元（Pseudodiosgenin）为关键活性化合物，与筛选出的靶点具有强结合能力。体外验证证实这些化合物抑制胶质瘤细胞增殖并诱导凋亡。Western blot分析确认SCL通过EGFR/Akt/mTOR和EGFR/STAT3通路抑制胶质瘤。综上，我们的发现全面阐明了SCL抗胶质瘤的活性化合物、潜在靶点及分子机制，为中药处方治疗该疾病的科学依据和治疗机制提供了有前景的策略。
